basics.name: Jordan Avery
basics.headline: Senior Data Engineer | Streaming pipelines, Python, AWS

summary.text: Data engineer with 8+ years building batch and streaming pipelines on AWS. Led migration of nightly ETL to event-driven processing and mentored a team of four engineers on testing and observability.

bullets.text: Led the migration of 40 nightly ETL jobs to Kafka-based streaming, cutting data freshness from 24 hours to 5 minutes for operations dashboards.
Designed a dbt modelling layer over Snowflake with tested contracts, reducing analyst ticket volume by 30% within two quarters.
Built an Airflow-based backfill framework that replays partitions idempotently, removing manual weekend recovery work.
Mentored four engineers on unit testing, data quality checks and on-call practices; two were promoted within a year.
Partnered with finance to define cost allocation tags in Terraform, lowering monthly AWS spend by 18% without reducing capacity.
Developed Spark jobs processing 2 TB of point-of-sale data daily to feed demand forecasting models used by 300 stores.
Introduced Great Expectations data checks into CI, catching schema drift before it reached production reports.
Rewrote a legacy cron-based ingestion service in Python with retries and alerting, raising pipeline success rate to 99.5%.
Collaborated with data scientists to productionize features in a shared PostgreSQL feature store with documented lineage.
Automated weekly sales reporting in SQL and Python, freeing 6 analyst hours per week for ad hoc investigations.
Maintained Tableau dashboards for regional managers and documented metric definitions in a shared glossary.
Wrote a small Kafka consumer lag exporter in Python with Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards, adopted by two teams.
